events.name: Love Flamenco
events.info: The LOVE FLAMENCO WORLD TOUR arrives in the United States with a vibrant show that captures the power, passion, and essence of authentic flamenco, recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage Humanity. The cast is led by acclaimed singer Antonio El Turry guitarist Marcos de Silvia, recipient of the paco de Lucia Foundation Grammy Scholarship; and dancers Fuensanta Blanco and Vero La India, known for their strength, elegance, and purity on stage. They are joined by Sevillian singer Ivan Carpio, rhythm and handclapping specialist Miguel El Cheyenne, and dancer Ricardo Fernandez El Tete a rising talent with a strong career in Spains leading flamenco venues. A sensory journey where music, dance, and emotion come together for an unforgettable night.

venues.name: Aztec Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office at The Aztec Theatre will be open on show dates only. We will open two hours before door time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Our bars and box office both accept ApplePay, GooglePay, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, & American Express. We are a cashless venue, and do not have an ATM on the premises. Cash to card is available upon request by asking any guest services member.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up at the Box Office starting at 2 hours prior to doors on the day of the event only. Please be sure to have the following: A VALID PHOTO ID, THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PURCHASE THE TICKETS, AND YOUR ORDER NUMBER. Guests are not permitted to put tickets in will call for other guests to pick up. You will need to arrange to meet your party at the facility to deliver tickets. If tickets or passes are being left for you - they will only be left at the box office. This includes meet and greet passes, backstage passes, press passes, and tickets from the tour or other promotional company. These tickets will be available approximately 1 hour before doors on the day of the show. If your tickets/passes are not in will call, you will need to contact the person that left them for you to determine where they are. The box office cannot contact any member of the tour for you.

venues.parkingDetail: The Aztec Theatre is located in the heart of downtown San Antonio at the corner of Commerce and St. Mary's. There are many parking garages within a few blocks walking distance to the venue. We do not have an attached parking garage. Please allow yourself extra time to park before arriving at the venue. Street parking is also available. Please be sure to pay close attention to any parking restrictions.

events.name: rockFit: Monster Mashup
events.description:
rockFit is more than just a workout, it’s a recurring community experience designed to bring San Antonio together through movement, health, and connection. From high-energy fitness classes to mindful wellness fairs, we’re transforming The Rock into the ultimate destination for your fitness journey, celebrating health at every level.

Sweat, socialize, and spookify your fitness routine this October as we team up with Gold's Gym and Discover Strength for rockFit: Monster Mashup, a Halloween-themed evening designed to get you moving, celebrate the holiday season, and refuel your body! 

While this event, classes, and fair are FREE and open to all fitness levels, a ticket is required. 

Space is limited, claim your free ticket today to join the rockFit community! 

Event Details: 
When: Friday, October 2 | 6:30PM - 10PM
Event Check-in: 6:30PM
Where: Frost Plaza at The Rock at La Cantera (1 Spurs Way)

What to Know:

Entry and parking to rockFit is FREE for all ages and fitness level.
This is an outdoor event, rain or shine.
Outside food and beverages are not permitted.
*Guests can enhance their experience by joining us at Roca & Martillo from 7PM - 10PM for a special 3-Course Prix-Fixe Menu only $25. Dinner is not included with your free ticket however show this ticket to your server to redeem this special dinner offer, valid only on October 2, 2026.

events.name: Carmina Burana ft. Harmonium of Texas and Guests
events.info: Join Harmonium of Texas for Opening Weekend and the beginning of a new chapter in San Antonio's musical history. Led by Artistic Director and Conductor Jeffrey Kahane, this inaugural performance of Carl Orff's monumental Carmina Burana features San Antonio Mastersingers, San Antonio Children's Chorus, and Youth Orchestras of San Antonio in a powerful celebration of community and artistic excellence. The program also includes Gabriela Ortiz's Antrópolis and Michael Torke's "Sky" Violin Concerto with acclaimed violinist Tessa Lark, Doors open at 6:30 PM. Performance begins at 7:30 PM at the Lila Cockrell Theatre. Harmonium of Texas is a new orchestra dedicated to presenting world-class performances, innovative collaborations, and transformative music education in San Antonio, Texas. For program details, artist information, and upcoming events, visit
